# C - Quality & Contracts

## When to Use
- Validating schema and contracts between layers
- Investigating nulls, duplicates, or outliers
- Auditing business rule compliance

## Procedure
1. Understand the expected contract or business rule.
2. Validate schema, nulls, ranges, and temporal consistency.
3. Identify root cause of inconsistencies.
4. Recommend concrete, verifiable fixes.

## Standards
- Never assume quality without evidence.
- Report failures with impact and origin.
